summary: Undertale entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Undertale

emulation.notes: Use the current native or official release route where available.

primary.why: Undertale's pixel-art fidelity is effectively preserved across platforms, so completeness drives the pick: the Switch version keeps the full base game and adds the sourced Mad Mew Mew secret boss/room content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Nintendo Switch version for the main run and include the Mad Mew Mew encounter after Mettaton EX. Use PC only for easy capture or mod/reference work, and sample other console shrine variants separately if desired.

secondary.exclusive_content: Dog Shrine / Dognation console gag and achievement-style material.
secondary.what_to_play: After reaching Papyrus's house, sample the Dog Shrine content; no full replay required.
secondary.why: Sourced console-specific room content, but not important enough to replace the Switch main run.

secondary.exclusive_content: Dog Casino / shrine variant and Mad Mew Mew placement differences.
secondary.what_to_play: Sample the shrine/casino variant after the relevant story point if documenting version differences.
secondary.why: Sourced console variant content, not a full-route replacement.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PC route with simple capture and mod/reference convenience.
all_releases.reason: skip: clean and historically important, but lacks console-exclusive shrine/boss content.

all_releases.fidelity: Console release with Dog Shrine variant content.
all_releases.reason: secondary: sample the Dog Shrine/Dognation material only if documenting console-exclusive gag/achievement content.

all_releases.fidelity: Full base game plus the Mad Mew Mew secret boss/room built for the Switch release.
all_releases.reason: primary: best completeness route without meaningful fidelity loss.

all_releases.fidelity: Xbox release with Dog Casino/Mad Mew Mew placement differences.
all_releases.reason: secondary: sample only the Dog Shrine/Casino variant if version-difference documentation matters.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PC is easiest to capture, but Switch has the most meaningful sourced exclusive boss content. Use Switch as primary, then sample PlayStation/Xbox shrine variants only as short secondary checks.

entries.remaster_caveats: Console extras are small but real. Undertale 3D/ports/mods and Deltarune are separate entries, not replacement routes for this game.
